//: Real sessions of the agents that built Reasontrail, trimmed and redacted by `pnpm samples:sessions`. Local ids only; the files live under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/ on the machine that built the app. `steps` is a range of step numbers of the untrimmed map, inclusive (CLI --trim). The first entry is the default sample. `displayTitle` (optional, ≤ 64 characters) is the showcase heading; the raw first request stays in the task card's "more" and the outline. `rewrite` applies to every sample, after redaction: each name becomes its replacement (word boundary, so possessives follow), and every sentence or line containing an `omitSentencesWith` term becomes `omission`.

samples.title: A verifier fails phase 12, an implementer fixes it, a second verifier passes
samples.displayTitle: Verify phase 12, fix the audit gap, re-verify
samples.why: The main agent delegates three times in a row: the verifier returns FAIL with one gap in the redaction audit, an implementer closes it, and a re-verify passes. Three subagent lanes; the first verifier's FAIL report is the trouble it shows (its scratch-file edits are not counted as churn).

samples.title: An implementer builds keyboard navigation, fails lint and typecheck, then fixes both
samples.displayTitle: Build keyboard navigation and a screen-reader table (phase 5)
samples.why: One whole implementer run: reads the plan, writes the keyboard tree logic and tests, hits two failed check runs in a row (an error streak), fixes them and ends with every check passing and three commits.

samples.title: The main agent takes a change request and has the planner rewrite the plan
samples.why: A product pivot: the main agent reads a change request, starts a planner that is cut off (a retry marker), folds in an addendum and runs a second planner that researches the session formats and rewrites the plan.
